grammar_title: 被动语态复习(Review of the Passive Voice)
source: 人教版2019选择性必修四 Unit 1 Discovering Useful Structures:被动语态复习(各时态被动 / 情态动词的被动 / 主动↔被动转换·by短语·不及物动词无被动·get done)。句子科幻主题且地道,被动形式为唯一正确项,干扰=主动/错时态被动。

points.point: 各时态的被动语态(is/was/will be/has been/had been/is being done)
points.overview: 主语是动作的承受者时用被动;be 的形式由时态决定:一般现在 am/is/are done、一般过去 was/were done、一般将来 will be done、现在完成 has/have been done、过去完成 had been done、现在进行 is/are being done、过去进行 was/were being done。

points.point: 情态动词的被动语态(can/must/should/may/might + be done)
points.overview: 情态动词后接 be done 构成被动:can be done、must be done、should be done、may/might be done、have to be done;否定与情态动词连用(cannot be done / must not be done)。

points.point: 主动↔被动转换 · by 短语 · 不及物动词无被动 · get done
points.overview: 及物动词才有被动;施动者用 by 引出;happen/appear/disappear/rise/fall/exist 等不及物动词没有被动;口语中常用 get done 表被动并强调结果或意外。

questions.stem: Robots first ____ in science fiction novels many years ago.
questions.explanation: appear 是不及物动词,无被动;主语是动作发出者,用主动一般过去 appeared。

questions.stem: Right now a new humanoid robot ____ in the laboratory next door.
questions.explanation: 现在此刻正在进行、主语是被造的对象 → 现在进行被动 is being built。

questions.stem: The whole surface of the earth ____ before the Time Traveller's eyes.
questions.explanation: 过去某时正在发生、地表是被改变的对象 → 过去进行被动 was being changed。

questions.stem: By the time he stopped the machine, the laboratory ____ completely.
questions.explanation: 在过去某动作之前已完成、实验室是被重建的对象 → 过去完成被动 had been rebuilt。

questions.stem: Sophia, the AI robot, ____ many times by reporters around the world.
questions.explanation: 对现在有影响且主语是被采访者 → 现在完成被动 has been interviewed。

questions.stem: The first Time Machine ____ at ten o'clock that very morning.
questions.explanation: 过去明确时间、机器是被启动的对象 → 一般过去被动 was started。

questions.stem: Robot soldiers ____ already ____ out in real war.
questions.explanation: test out 及物、主语是被测试对象、对现在有影响 → 现在完成被动 have been tested。

questions.stem: These days many household tasks ____ by smart machines.
questions.explanation: 一般现在的习惯性事实、任务是被完成的对象 → 一般现在被动 are done。

questions.stem: A 3,000-seat venue ____ for the robot science fair next month.
questions.explanation: 将来、场馆是被建造的对象 → 一般将来被动 will be built。

questions.stem: When I entered the room, I found the salesman's salary ____ at the meeting.
questions.explanation: 进入房间那一刻正在进行、薪水是被讨论的对象 → 过去进行被动 was being discussed。

questions.stem: The Three-Body Problem ____ into English by Ken Liu in 2014.
questions.explanation: 过去明确施动者、小说是被翻译的对象 → 一般过去被动 was translated。

questions.stem: At present, dangerous tasks ____ to robots rather than to people.
questions.explanation: 一般现在的普遍做法、任务是被交付的对象 → 一般现在被动 are given。

questions.stem: Many strange things ____ before his eyes as the machine sped up.
questions.explanation: 过去那段时间正在进行、事物是被闪现的对象 → 过去进行被动 were being flashed。

questions.stem: So far, the AI device ____ no serious mistake in its calculations.
questions.explanation: device 是动作发出者(犯错的主体)、对现在有影响 → 现在完成主动 has made;非被动。

questions.stem: Night came as if a lamp ____ by an unseen hand.
questions.explanation: 过去那一刻正在发生、灯是被熄灭的对象 → 过去进行被动 was being turned out。

questions.stem: Citizenship ____ to Sophia by a country for the first time in history.
questions.explanation: 过去发生、公民身份是被授予的对象 → 一般过去被动 was given。

questions.stem: Each year more science fiction films ____ by studios all over the world.
questions.explanation: 一般现在的反复事实、影片是被制作的对象 → 一般现在被动 are produced。

questions.stem: He felt as if he ____ fast along a winding road through time.
questions.explanation: 过去那一刻正在进行、他是被驱赶/带动的对象 → 过去进行被动 was being driven。

questions.stem: By next year, smart robots ____ into thousands of ordinary homes.
questions.explanation: 到将来某时点之前完成、机器人是被引入的对象 → 将来完成被动 will have been introduced。

questions.stem: Before the party began, the whole house ____ by Tony.
questions.explanation: 在过去动作之前已完成、房子是被改造的对象 → 过去完成被动 had been transformed。

questions.stem: A robot may not injure a human being, and a human ____ from harm.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 must 后接 be done;human 是被保护的对象 → must be protected。

questions.stem: Batteries ____ in checked luggage, as they might explode due to overheating.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 can 否定后接 be done;电池是被携带的对象 → cannot be carried。

questions.stem: Mobile phones ____ during the robotics conference.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 must + be done;手机是被关闭的对象 → must be switched off。

questions.stem: The damaged robot ____ before it is sent back to work.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 must + be done;robot 是被修理的对象 → must be repaired。

questions.stem: Such a serious safety problem ____ at once by the engineers.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 should + be done;deal with 为动词短语,被动保留 with → should be dealt with。

questions.stem: The three laws of robotics ____ by every machine without exception.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 must + be done;laws 是被遵守的对象 → must be obeyed。

questions.stem: Any order given by a human ____ unless it conflicts with the First Law.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 should + be done;order 是被遵循的对象 → should be followed。

questions.stem: Two hundred grammes of flour ____ to the cake mix by the kitchen robot.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 should + be done;flour 是被加入的对象 → should be added。

questions.stem: These dangerous experiments ____ only inside a sealed laboratory.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 can + be done;experiments 是被做的对象 → can be done。

questions.stem: It is hoped that such powerful AI ____ for good rather than for war.
questions.explanation: will + be done 构成将来被动;AI 是被使用的对象 → will be used。

questions.stem: More care ____ when robots are allowed to drive on busy roads.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 must + be done;care 是被采取的对象 → must be taken。

questions.stem: The space project ____ if the company runs out of money.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 may + be done;project 是被暂停的对象 → may be suspended。

questions.stem: Personal data collected by the device ____ to strangers.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 must 否定 + be done;data 是被出售的对象 → must not be sold。

questions.stem: An AI conference of this size ____ months in advance.
questions.explanation: have to 后接 be done;conference 是被筹划的对象 → has to be planned。

questions.stem: If a robot breaks the law, who ____ responsible for the harm?
questions.explanation: 情态动词 should + be done;hold sb responsible 的被动 → should be held。

questions.stem: The new software ____ before the robot leaves the factory.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 must + be done;software 是被测试的对象 → must be tested out。

questions.stem: Such a wild idea about time travel ____ too quickly.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 should 否定 + be done;idea 是被否定的对象 → should not be dismissed。

questions.stem: Carry-on luggage of this weight ____ on board by airline rules.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 can 否定 + be done;luggage 是被允许的对象 → cannot be allowed。

questions.stem: All members of the panel ____ smartly at the science fair.
questions.explanation: be dressed 表'穿着'的被动状态;members 由 should + be done 引导 → should be dressed。

questions.stem: A clear warning ____ before any robot is switched on for the first time.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 should + be done;warning 是被给出的对象 → should be given。

questions.stem: After the great earthquake, no one knows exactly what ____ to the lab.
questions.explanation: happen 是不及物动词,没有被动 → 用主动 happened。

questions.stem: The strange machine ____ suddenly and was never seen again.
questions.explanation: disappear 不及物,无被动 → 主动 disappeared。

questions.stem: With a sudden jolt, the Time Machine ____ on its side.
questions.explanation: 口语中 get done 表被动并强调意外结果;机器是被翻倒的对象 → got flipped。

questions.stem: The book first attracted attention when it ____ by Chinese-American author Ken Liu.
questions.explanation: by 引出施动者、小说是承受者 → 被动 was translated。

questions.stem: Many serious accidents ____ before the safety rules were finally written.
questions.explanation: happen 不及物无被动,过去完成用主动 → had happened。

questions.stem: Although the robot looked human, the audience ____ by its smooth, fixed face.
questions.explanation: 观众是被骗的对象 → 被动 was fooled(主动 fooled 主语应是施动者)。

questions.stem: A strange light ____ in the sky just before the machine vanished.
questions.explanation: appear 不及物,无被动 → 主动 appeared。

questions.stem: We turned the active sentence "Scientists built the robot" into "The robot ____ by scientists."
questions.explanation: 主动变被动:宾语 robot 作主语、动词变 was built、施动者用 by → was built。

questions.stem: The careless driver was lucky that his self-driving car ____ in the crash.
questions.explanation: get done 表被动、强调意外;car 是承受者的否定形式 → did not get damaged。

questions.stem: Over many years, a deep division slowly ____ between humans and machines.
questions.explanation: rise 不及物,无被动 → 主动过去 rose。

questions.stem: "People will soon forget these old robots" becomes "These old robots ____ soon."
questions.explanation: 主动变将来被动:宾语作主语、will be done → will be forgotten。

questions.stem: The young engineer ____ when his very first robot suddenly came to life.
questions.explanation: engineer 是被震惊的对象 → 被动 was stunned(stunning 用于使人震惊的事物)。

questions.stem: Nothing strange ____ during the whole test, so the team felt relieved.
questions.explanation: happen 不及物,无被动 → 主动 happened。

questions.stem: In the rush, the fragile sensor ____ and had to be replaced.
questions.explanation: get done 表被动、强调意外结果;sensor 是承受者 → got broken。

questions.stem: The old laws of robotics ____ by Isaac Asimov in the 1940s.
questions.explanation: by 引出施动者、laws 是被创造的对象 → 被动 were created。

questions.stem: Once switched on, the AI assistant ____ and began to answer every question.
options: was woken up by itself and
questions.explanation: wake up 在此为不及物(自己醒来),用主动 → woke up。

questions.stem: We rewrote "Someone is repairing the robot" as "The robot ____ now."
questions.explanation: 主动现在进行变被动:is being done → is being repaired。

questions.stem: Such a powerful AI did not simply ____; it was carefully designed over years.
questions.explanation: exist 不及物,无被动 → 主动原形 exist。

questions.stem: During the storm the antenna ____ off the roof and stopped working.
questions.explanation: get done 表被动、强调意外;antenna 是承受者 → got knocked。

questions.stem: "Liu Cixin wrote the novel" can be rewritten as "The novel ____ by Liu Cixin."
questions.explanation: 主动变一般过去被动:was done + by 施动者 → was written。
